name_reason: Name is fully compliant and accurate. Prefix data_fd2_ (game global), domain chapter (chapter end-scene / ending-cinematic tables, lives in chtab2.c), descriptor ending_credit_roll_top_portrait_id_table precisely describes content: the game-clear ending cinematic's staff/credit roll, the top-half fighter's portrait id, and the table data type. No Ghidra address residue (no hex suffix equal to its own address 0x525dc or any data address). Reflects data type (table/array). Verified against the single reader fd2_play_game_ending_cinematic.
purpose: Top-half fighter portrait id for each of the 20 staff-roll duels shown during the game-clear ending cinematic credit roll.
logic_summary: fd2_play_game_ending_cinematic (@0x2bce5) copies all 20 bytes onto its stack via a MOVSD x5 block copy (src ESI=0x525dc @0x2bd1f/0x2bd24, dst [ESP+0x28]=abStack_3c). In the credit-roll loop (char_idx 0..0x13) it reads one byte per iteration: MOVZX ECX,byte[ESP+EBX+0x28] (@0x2c31e), CMP ECX,0x4C (@0x2c323); < 0x4C -> runtime_char[0].bTeam=2 else 0, then MOV runtime_char[0].bPortrait_id,CL (store at [0x53a45]+0x7, @0x2c26c). runtime_char[0] is the top fighter. Companion bottom table 0x525f0 feeds runtime_char[1]; scripted_outcome table 0x52604 feeds data_fd2_battle_scripted_cinematic_mode_or_terrain_idx. Block copy as 5 dwords is a speed optimization; access is per-byte across all 20 entries.
element_semantics: Per-duel (index 0..19) portrait id of the top-half fighter in that staff-roll duel; read unsigned, stride 1. An entry value >= 0x4C places the top fighter on the enemy side (bTeam=0), otherwise the player side (bTeam=2).
notes: Single reader (no writers): fd2_play_game_ending_cinematic @0x2bd24 [READ] and @0x2bd1f [DATA]. Memory bytes verified byte-identical to src initializer (0x33,0x6E,0x13,0x69,0x36,0x75,0x1E,0x7B,0x27,0x7F,0x40,0x51,0x34,0x7D,0x1A,0x73,0x29,0x5B,0x1F,0x7E). Source comment block (chtab2.c lines 226-237) is already precise and matches disassembly, so kept unchanged (no Edit to src). Ghidra data plate was blank (<null>); created a concise PLATE_COMMENT summary via run_script_inline (data plate mechanism per project_ghidra_data_plate_mechanism). const confirmed: zero game-side write-xrefs and src declares const uint8.
